name: factory
description: Software factory skills: factory-tuned copies of scope, scope-review, build, and ship that read a per-attempt run file, handle questions without a human, and write typed stage results, so a local runner can turn one interactively scoped change request into a ready pull request unattended. Use when running a change through the factory CLI rather than invoking dev skills by hand.
